specification_compliance: Every scope-drift claim from TP-1 to TP-6 holds against the files at HEAD: each named file or behaviour exists and is absent from the touch-point list in docs/specs/no-horizontal-scroll-on-mouse.md.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Removing the mouse-only press-and-hold scroll arrows from ClipFramesSection is a UI removal that no touch point declares.
The `inert` hiding of rows past the shelf cap in ShelfBlock is a focus/accessibility behaviour the spec does not cover. The static fixture does not reproduce it.
regression_risks: The e2e fixture's buildShelf sets no `inert`, so the layout spec does not exercise the shelf's hidden-row focus handling. Only the unit tests cover it.
test_coverage: shelfHiddenRows.test.ts and ShelfBlock.hiddenRows.test.tsx cover the hidden-row mechanism.
The addon tests assert the mouse:overflow-y-auto / max-h classes.
not_verified: I could not run git diff against origin/develop, so whether each hunk is new was inferred from the HEAD file contents.
